title: 2022 NAICS Sector 31-33 — Manufacturing
authority_scope: Official North American industry classification and definition for manufacturing establishments.
limitations: Industry classification is not an analytical-method taxonomy.
Country-specific detail below harmonized NAICS levels varies.

title: ISA-95 Series of Standards: Enterprise-Control System Integration
supports: production quality maintenance and inventory operations
authority_scope: Consensus standard family for manufacturing operations management and enterprise-control integration across discrete, batch, continuous, and logistics operations.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Levels are an activity/integration model and must not be mistaken for mandatory network topology.

title: IEC 61512-1:2026 Batch control — Models and terminology
authority_scope: International reference model for batch and related procedure-oriented process manufacturing control.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Does not by itself define analytical studies.

title: ISO 22400-1:2014 Manufacturing operations management KPIs
authority_scope: International framework for defining, composing, exchanging, and using MOM KPIs.
limitations: KPIs are observations or inputs, not complete analytical cases.
Full normative text is paywalled.

title: ISO 7870-1:2019 Control charts — General guidelines
authority_scope: International guidance on the philosophy and families of control charts.
limitations: Part 1 does not specify each statistical control method.
Method choice still depends on distribution, autocorrelation, rational subgroup, and sampling design.

title: ISO 7870-6:2024 EWMA control charts for the process mean
authority_scope: International standard for EWMA mean-shift monitoring.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Assumptions and false-alarm control must be established per process.

title: ISO 13374-1:2003 Condition monitoring and diagnostics — General guidelines
authority_scope: International guidelines for data processing, communication, and presentation of machine condition information.
limitations: Does not prescribe a universal diagnostic algorithm.
Full normative text is paywalled.

title: ISO 13374-2:2007 Condition monitoring and diagnostics — Data processing
authority_scope: International reference information and processing models for open condition monitoring and diagnostics architectures.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Specific sensing modalities require additional standards and calibration evidence.

title: ISO 14224:2016 Reliability and maintenance data for equipment
authority_scope: International reliability and maintenance data exchange basis for petroleum, petrochemical, and natural-gas facilities with portable equipment-data concepts.
limitations: Industry scope is petroleum and related facilities.
It defines data requirements more than analysis methods.

title: NASA Reliability-Centered Maintenance Guide
authority_scope: NASA engineering guidance for maintenance strategy, condition monitoring, and failure analysis.
limitations: Agency guidance is not a universally binding manufacturing standard.
Local asset criticality and safety authority remain necessary.

title: Digital Twins for Advanced Manufacturing
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: observe diagnose predict optimize use cases
authority_scope: NIST measurement-science and standards program for trustworthy manufacturing digital twins.
limitations: Project guidance is not a conformance standard.
A synchronized model is not automatically valid for a decision.

title: Current Standards Landscape for Smart Manufacturing Systems
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: product production-system and business lifecycle dimensions
authority_scope: NISTIR landscape of standards for smart-manufacturing integration.
limitations: Published in 2016; later editions of cited standards must be checked.
Landscape coverage is not evidence of provider conformance.

title: Operations-driven Performance Measurement for Smart Manufacturing Systems
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST measurement-science program for operations-driven manufacturing performance analysis.
limitations: Research program outputs require method-specific validation.
Performance metrics alone do not identify causes.

title: Core Manufacturing Simulation Data: Standard representation for manufacturing simulation information
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: production planning scheduling and inventory simulation
authority_scope: NIST description of the SISO CMSD neutral manufacturing simulation information model.
limitations: CMSD is not an all-inclusive manufacturing or simulation ontology.
Simulation validity still requires calibration and scenario evidence.

title: Simulation is a Window Into the Future of Your Manufacturing Operation
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST Manufacturing Extension Partnership guidance on discrete-event manufacturing simulation applications.
limitations: Practice article rather than normative standard.
Simulation output is conditional on model structure and input fidelity.

title: MTConnect Standard version 2.5
authority_scope: Open standard and normative model for retrieving structured information from manufacturing equipment.
limitations: MTConnect is primarily observational rather than a general command protocol.
Adapters may lose vendor-specific semantics.

title: OPC Unified Architecture Core
authority_scope: Core industrial interoperability specification spanning sensors, controllers, MES, ERP, and IIoT.
limitations: Core UA permits vendor-defined models; semantic interoperability requires companion models and profiles.
Read and command authority must be separated.

title: SEMI Standards — Information and Control
authority_scope: Official SEMI standard-family catalogue for semiconductor equipment control, data acquisition, process diagnostics, and manufacturing data management.
limitations: Normative standard texts are separately licensed.
Fab-specific object mappings and sampling plans remain necessary.

title: Next-generation SEMI Equipment Data Acquisition standards
authority_scope: Official description of the SEMI EDA or Interface A standards suite.
limitations: Article summarizes a standards suite rather than reproducing normative requirements.
Collection must not impair equipment control performance.

title: IPC-2591 Connected Factory Exchange
supports: factory material resource and performance data
authority_scope: Open electronics-assembly factory information-exchange standard maintained by IPC.
limitations: Normative standard text is separately licensed.
Version compatibility and endpoint qualification must be verified.

title: IPC-1782 Manufacturing and Supply Chain Traceability of Electronic Products
authority_scope: IPC standard for manufacturing and supply-chain traceability of electronic products.
limitations: Preview and table-of-contents material do not replace the licensed normative standard.
Traceability level is agreed between user and supplier.

title: Quality Information Framework 4.0
authority_scope: Official DMSC description of the XML-based CAD-agnostic QIF manufacturing quality standard.
limitations: Implementation claims require conformance testing.
QIF does not remove measurement uncertainty or calibration obligations.

title: End-to-End Quality Information Framework Technology Survey
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: metrology data exchange from design through reporting
authority_scope: NISTIR survey of QIF information models and manufacturing-quality lifecycle exchange.
limitations: Published in 2016 and describes an earlier QIF edition.
Survey evidence does not prove a specific implementation is lossless.

title: Automotive Quality Core Tools: APQP, Control Plan, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC
authority_scope: Official AIAG overview of automotive quality core-tool methods developed with automakers.
limitations: Manual details are separately licensed.
Core-tool completion does not itself prove process capability or product conformity.

title: Minimum Automotive Quality Management System Requirements for Sub-tier Suppliers
authority_scope: IATF and automotive-industry minimum QMS requirements for sub-tier suppliers.
limitations: Not a substitute for the licensed IATF 16949 standard or OEM-specific requirements.
Revision and customer applicability must be checked.

title: Parts Manufacturer Approval — Regulations and Policies
authority_scope: FAA regulatory and guidance entry point for aircraft-parts production approval.
limitations: Applicability varies by approval basis and article.
Linked regulations and current advisory circular revisions remain authoritative.

title: AC 21-26A Quality Control for the Manufacture of Composite Structures
authority_scope: FAA acceptable means of compliance for quality systems manufacturing fiber-reinforced aircraft structures.
limitations: Advisory circular is nonmandatory unless its means are chosen.
Specific approved data and certification basis govern.

title: Safety Management Systems for Design and Manufacturing Organizations
authority_scope: FAA requirements and guidance for safety management systems of applicable Part 21 design and production organizations.
limitations: Applicability depends on certificate and approval type.
Safety analytics cannot replace accountable safety decisions.

title: Process Validation: General Principles and Practices
supports: process design qualification and continued verification
authority_scope: FDA guidance for lifecycle validation of drug and biologic manufacturing processes.
limitations: Nonbinding guidance; applicable statutes and regulations control.
Statistical plans must be justified for the specific process and risk.

title: PAT — Framework for Innovative Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, and Quality Assurance
authority_scope: FDA regulatory framework encouraging process measurement, analysis, control, and quality assurance in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
limitations: Voluntary framework and nonbinding guidance.
Analytical models require validated intended use.

title: Q13 Continuous Manufacturing of Drug Substances and Drug Products
authority_scope: FDA-adopted ICH guidance on development, operation, and lifecycle management of integrated continuous drug manufacturing.
limitations: Nonbinding guidance.
Scope and control strategy are product and process specific.

title: Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP: Questions and Answers
authority_scope: FDA guidance clarifying data-integrity expectations under drug CGMP.
limitations: Nonbinding guidance.
Predicate rules and record context determine requirements.

title: Quality Management System Regulation
authority_scope: Current FDA quality-management regulation context for finished medical-device manufacturers effective 2026-02-02.
limitations: Specific device exemptions and supplemental FDA provisions apply.
Regulatory interpretation must use current rule text.

title: Part 11 Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures — Scope and Application
authority_scope: FDA guidance on Part 11 electronic records and signatures used under predicate rules.
limitations: Predicate-rule applicability must be established record by record.
Nonbinding guidance.

title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice Regulations
supports: drug manufacturing methods facilities and controls
batch identity strength quality and purity
authority_scope: FDA regulatory entry point for drug CGMP requirements.
limitations: Page summarizes and links controlling regulations.
Product-specific application and current guidance must be assessed.

title: Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals
authority_scope: OSHA requirements and official guidance for covered highly hazardous chemical processes.
limitations: Coverage depends on chemical and threshold applicability.
Analytics support but do not discharge employer duties or expert review.

title: Risk Management Program Rule
authority_scope: EPA Clean Air Act Section 112(r) risk-management requirements for covered facilities using extremely hazardous substances.
limitations: Rule is under active revision; effective provisions and dates must be checked.
Facility applicability is threshold and process specific.

title: Best Available Techniques Reference Documents
publisher: European Commission Joint Research Centre EU-BRITE
supports: chemical metals cement glass pulp and paper process coverage
authority_scope: Official EU reference repository supporting Industrial Emissions Directive permitting and BAT conclusions.
limitations: Legal applicability is EU installation and permit specific.
BREF editions and BAT conclusions vary by sector.

title: Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprint Assumptions and Definitions
supports: process heating cooling and machine-drive energy
authority_scope: DOE definitions and assumptions supporting manufacturing energy and carbon footprints.
limitations: National footprint assumptions are not a substitute for calibrated plant submetering.
Published basis is older and should be versioned.

title: Industrial Decarbonization Roadmap
supports: iron steel chemicals food refining and cement pathways
authority_scope: DOE roadmap for technology pathways and system boundaries toward industrial decarbonization.
limitations: Roadmap scenarios are not facility-specific compliance factors.
Technology readiness and grid factors change over time.

title: ISO 20140-1:2019 Environmental performance of manufacturing systems
authority_scope: International principles for evaluating environmental performance of whole or partial manufacturing systems.
limitations: Product lifecycle assessment is explicitly outside scope.
Full normative text is paywalled.

title: ISO 20140-5:2024 Environmental performance evaluation data
authority_scope: International data-class specification for environmental performance evaluation of manufacturing facilities or parts.
limitations: Does not define exchange protocol or enabled analytical function.
Full normative text is paywalled.

title: Additive Manufacturing Part Qualification
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST measurement-science program for qualification of additive-manufactured parts.
limitations: Research outputs do not constitute a universal certification basis.
Material, machine, process, and application qualification remain distinct.

title: In-process monitoring and non-destructive evaluation for metal additive manufacturing processes
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NISTIR review of state-of-the-art metal additive in-process monitoring and NDE methods and standards.
limitations: Review identifies unresolved gaps; monitoring is not automatically a qualified acceptance method.
Applicability varies by additive process and material.

title: Manufacturing Activities Panel — Li-ion Batteries
supports: battery material cell and pack manufacturing flow
authority_scope: DOE manufacturing value-chain view and quality-control priorities for lithium-ion batteries.
limitations: Program material rather than normative manufacturing standard.
Chemistry and form-factor-specific process controls differ.

title: Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
authority_scope: Official annual U.S. government statistics for more than 90 nonfuel minerals and materials.
limitations: Macro commodity data do not describe plant process state.
Trade and production estimates can be revised.

title: Industry Sector Emissions
authority_scope: Official EPA inventory explanation and links for industrial greenhouse-gas emissions.
limitations: Inventory factors and facility reporting methods are not interchangeable.
Current reporting rules govern facility calculations.

title: FSMA Final Rule for Preventive Controls for Human Food
authority_scope: FDA requirements and implementation context for hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls in covered food facilities.
limitations: Exemptions and modified requirements vary by facility and activity.
Current eCFR controls.

title: Food Traceability Final Rule
authority_scope: FDA traceability recordkeeping framework for covered foods and supply-chain activities.
limitations: Compliance timing and flexibilities are changing; current effective dates must be checked.
Only covered foods and activities are in scope.

title: HACCP Validation
publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
authority_scope: USDA FSIS regulatory guidance for validating HACCP systems in meat and poultry establishments.
limitations: Scope is FSIS-regulated establishments.
Scientific support and in-plant validation are both required; a generic model is insufficient.

title: Digital Thread for Smart Manufacturing
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST integration program for product, manufacturing, inspection, and support information across the lifecycle.
limitations: Program demonstrations do not establish universal lossless interoperability.
Identity and version alignment remain implementation obligations.

title: ISO 23952:2020 Quality information framework
authority_scope: International QIF information model for manufacturing quality information.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Carrier conformance does not guarantee semantic or metrological validity.

title: Smart Manufacturing Operations Planning and Control Program
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST program framing measurement science for smart manufacturing operations planning and control.
limitations: Program concluded in 2018 and later standards must be checked.
Methods require asset and decision-specific validation.

title: ISA-18 Series of Standards — Alarm Management
authority_scope: Consensus standards and technical reports for alarm systems across process and related industries.
limitations: Full normative texts are separately licensed.
Alarm-rate metrics alone cannot establish safe operation.

title: IEC 61511-1:2016 Functional safety for the process industry sector
authority_scope: International process-industry requirements for specification, design, installation, operation, and maintenance of safety instrumented systems.
limitations: Functional-safety judgment requires competent persons and full normative text.
Analytics must not bypass independent protection layers.

title: IEC 62061:2021 Safety of machinery — Functional safety of safety-related control systems
authority_scope: International machinery-sector functional-safety standard for safety-related control systems.
limitations: Full normative text is paywalled.
Risk assessment and legal jurisdiction determine application.

title: ISA/IEC 62443 Series — Industrial automation and control systems security
authority_scope: Consensus cybersecurity standards for industrial automation and control systems across sectors.
limitations: Full normative standards are separately licensed.
Security analytics cannot be allowed to degrade safety or control performance.

title: Additive Manufacturing Standards
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: NIST standards and measurement resources for industrial additive manufacturing.
limitations: Referenced standards have distinct scopes and editions.
Benchmarks are not product certification.

title: Smart Manufacturing Platforms for Battery Production
authority_scope: DOE program requirements identifying manufacturing analytics and platform needs for next-generation batteries.
limitations: Funding opportunity defines research priorities rather than validated production practice.
Specific chemistry and equipment evidence is required.

title: Simantha — Simulation for Manufacturing
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
authority_scope: Public NIST discrete-event simulation implementation for asynchronous manufacturing lines.
limitations: Reference software is not a universal plant model.
User models and stochastic inputs require validation.

title: Greenhouse Gas Reporting — Iron and Steel Production
authority_scope: EPA official information sheet for mandatory GHG reporting by covered iron and steel facilities.
limitations: Current 40 CFR Part 98 methods control.
Reporting calculations are not necessarily product carbon footprints.

title: Process of 3D Printing Medical Devices
authority_scope: FDA explanation of additive medical-device process stages and validation expectations.
limitations: Overview is not a product-specific clearance or manufacturing specification.
Device-specific tests and standards govern.
